symbols.name: AuthManager
symbols.doc: Authentication Manager for The Rift. Handles local Guest mode and Supabase Google OAuth / Email OTP with 1-month session persistence.

symbols.name: AuthManager.loginAsGuest
symbols.doc: Log in / switch to Guest mode. All data is saved locally on device.

symbols.name: AuthManager.sendOtp
symbols.doc: Request a one-time OTP code or magic link to be sent to the player's email.

symbols.name: AuthManager.setGuestName
symbols.doc: Update the display name for the guest user.

symbols.name: AuthManager.signInWithGoogle
symbols.doc: Initiates Google OAuth sign-in via Supabase. Redirects the player to the Google account consent screen.

symbols.name: AuthManager.signOut
symbols.doc: Sign out from the current account. Automatically reverts to Guest mode.

symbols.name: AuthManager.verifyOtp
symbols.doc: Verify the 6-digit OTP code received by the player via email. On success, establishes a session persisted for 1 month.

symbols.name: AuthModalScreen
symbols.doc: Modular Auth Modal Screen. Provides local Guest authorization and Google OAuth login via Supabase.

symbols.name: BiomeManager.advanceStage
symbols.doc: Advances to the next stage/biome. Caps at stage 4 (final stage).

symbols.name: BiomeManager.applyBiomeToScene

symbols.name: BiomeManager.setStage

symbols.name: BloodBatsWeapon
symbols.doc: Blood Bats Weapon (Стая летучих мышей) Summons swarms of ravenous shadowy blood bats with glowing crimson eyes. Unlike other weapons, bats target random living enemies in range (not closest), and fly in erratic, chaotic sinusoidal flutter paths. Deals impact damage and applies stacking bleed; 1% of bleed damage heals the hero. Scales from 4 bats at level 1 up to 24 bats at max level (level 8).

symbols.name: BowWeapon
symbols.doc: Hunting Bow (Охотничий Лук) Long-range sharp piercing arrows cutting through lines of enemies

symbols.name: calculateBattlePassPoints
symbols.doc: Calculates Battle Pass experience points awarded for a run based on survival time: - < 5 minutes (0..299s): 20 points - < 10 minutes (300..599s): 50 points - < 15 minutes (600..899s): 100 points - < 20 minutes (900..1199s): 150 points - < 30 minutes (1200..1799s): 200 points - >= 30 minutes (Victory): 200 points

symbols.name: canAcquireInvokerWeapon
symbols.doc: Separate spell weapons require Invoke in the same inventory, and hero must be allowed to acquire.

symbols.name: canCharacterAcquireWeapon
symbols.doc: The single source of truth for whether a hero is allowed to acquire or upgrade a weapon. Rules: 1. If weapon is exclusive to hero X, only hero X can acquire it. 2. If hero is a unique character (e.g. Invoker): - They can only acquire weapons from their exclusive list. - They CANNOT acquire generic weapons (bow, katana, etc.) unless allowGenericWeapons is explicitly true. - Sub-prerequisites (like having invoker_invoke) are evaluated. 3. If hero is a non-unique character (Ronin, Valkyrie, Archer, etc.): - They CANNOT acquire any exclusive weapon (like invoker_invoke or any invoker spell). - They can acquire any generic non-exclusive weapon.

symbols.name: canRerollWeaponOptions
symbols.doc: Determines whether the current weapon selection qualifies for a reroll. Per rule: reroll is allowed if and only if all three choices are new weapons.

symbols.name: ChakramWeapon
symbols.doc: Chakram (Танцующий Чакрам) Boomerang spinning blades returning to player

symbols.name: CharacterAnimator
symbols.doc: Procedural kinematic animation controller for realistic and natural character movement. Features smooth state cross-fading, biomechanical walk/run cycles, and class-specific combat attacks.

symbols.name: CharacterAnimator
symbols.doc: Modular Character Animator Handles directional sprite state machines, UV repeat/offset calculations, and Three.js material bindings across 4 animation states: - IDLE: состояние покоя - WALK: состояние движения - IDLE_ATTACK: состояние атаки в покое - WALK_ATTACK: атака в движении

symbols.name: CharacterAnimLayout
symbols.doc: Grid layout specification for directional spritesheets.

symbols.name: CharacterAnimStateConfig
symbols.doc: State configuration for animation timing and playback.

symbols.name: CharacterModularSystem
symbols.doc: Modular equipment and class visual identity builder for Warrior, Archer, and Mage.

symbols.name: CharacterModularSystem.updateVFX
symbols.doc: VFX Update loop (spins crystal and particles)

symbols.name: CharacterPreviewRenderer
symbols.doc: Renders an animated 2.5D chibi hero preview on the character selection dais.

symbols.name: CharacterRig
symbols.doc: Procedural stylized humanoid rig and anatomy builder. Uses hierarchical Three.js Object3D nodes representing bones and smooth anatomical geometry.

symbols.name: CharacterSelectScreen

symbols.name: CharacterType

symbols.name: ChartSeries

symbols.name: ChestManager.getStageChestTiers
symbols.doc: Returns a deterministic list of chest tiers for the given stage and count, shuffled with the provided PRNG. Stage 1: 11 small, 4 large, 0 legendary Stage 2: 10 small, 5 large, 0 legendary Stage 3: 0 small, 11 large, 4 legendary Stage 4+: 0 small, 4 large, 11 legendary

symbols.name: ChestManager.update
symbols.doc: Updates floating chest hologram visuals, pulse aura, and opening animations.

symbols.name: ChestsRenderer
symbols.doc: Declarative R3F container for stage chests. Manages chest object lifecycle and mounting within R3F.

symbols.name: ChunkManager.clear
symbols.doc: Deep cleanup of all chunk geometries and entities.

symbols.name: ChunkManager.cull
symbols.doc: Frustum Culling: Hides chunks that are completely outside the camera view. Keeps active rendering to only the 6-9 chunks in front of the camera.

symbols.name: ChunkManager.getElevation
symbols.doc: Returns terrain elevation Y at world coordinate (x, z) (always 0 for 2D/2.5D pixel art consistency).

symbols.name: ChunkManager.getNormal
symbols.doc: Returns surface normal vector at world coordinate (x, z).

symbols.name: ChunkManager.getSlowFactor
symbols.doc: Returns rough terrain slow multiplier (0.65 on dunes/rough zones, 1.0 normally).

symbols.name: ChunkManager.update
symbols.doc: With the fixed preloaded map, update does not need to stream or unload chunks. Runs in 0ms without runtime memory allocation.

symbols.name: CloudSyncManager

symbols.name: CloudSyncManager.resetCloudProgress
symbols.doc: Resets all game progress in local memory and in the cloud for the current account.

symbols.name: CloudSyncManager.saveToCloud
symbols.doc: Directly uploads current local state to player_profiles in Supabase.

symbols.name: CloudSyncManager.scheduleSave
symbols.doc: Debounced cloud save after any local mutation.

symbols.name: CloudSyncManager.syncOnLogin
symbols.doc: Called when a player logs in via Google/Email. Pulls existing cloud save or uploads guest progress if cloud row is empty.

symbols.name: DedicatedGameServer.onPlayerJoin
symbols.doc: Handles player connection (programmatic)

symbols.name: DedicatedGameServer.stop

symbols.name: DevManager.setCurrentSeed

symbols.name: disposeReactUI

symbols.name: SPELL_SPHERE_RECIPES
symbols.doc: Formula combinations for each of the 10 spells matching authentic Dota 2 / Invoker lore

symbols.name: SpellControlState
symbols.doc: Countdown state shared by the browser and dedicated simulation.

symbols.name: SulfurSmokeManager
symbols.doc: Global manager for Brimstone / Sulfur Smoke teleport and disappearance effects.

symbols.name: SulfurSmokeVfxInstance
symbols.doc: Individual instance of the Brimstone Smoke cloud VFX. Plays sequential 6-frame animation with initial bright light burst followed by expanding and dissipating violet-black / dark blue sulfur smoke.

symbols.name: SummonUndeadWeapon
symbols.doc: Summon Undead Weapon (Призыв мёртвых) Exclusive / signature weapon of the Necromancer: summons and commands a horde of skeletal warriors that pursue and slash enemies in melee combat, protecting their master.

symbols.name: TerrainElevation
symbols.doc: Procedural Terrain Elevation Generator. Provides deterministic, continuous, multi-octave height and analytical normals for the 500x500 meter game world.

symbols.name: TerrainElevation.getElevation
symbols.doc: Returns flat ground elevation Y = 0 to preserve 2D/2.5D pixel-art plane consistency.

symbols.name: TerrainElevation.getNormal
symbols.doc: Returns flat ground normal (0, 1, 0).

symbols.name: TerrainElevation.setSeed
symbols.doc: Reconfigures harmonic parameters based on seed for varied topography per stage.

symbols.name: TerrainMaterials
symbols.doc: Reusable shared materials for high performance and low draw overhead

symbols.name: TerrainProps.createBoulder
symbols.doc: Builds an earthy sandstone boulder formation.

symbols.name: TerrainProps.createCactus
symbols.doc: Builds an authentic 3D Saguaro Cactus with fluting and 0-2 curved arms.

symbols.name: TerrainProps.createOasis
symbols.doc: Builds an expansive desert oasis landmark with turquoise pool, wet sand shoreline, perimeter palm trees, smooth river stones and reeds. Player and enemies cannot enter the water (solid collision registered via ObstacleManager).

symbols.name: TerrainProps.createPalmTree
symbols.doc: Builds an authentic desert palm tree with curved segmented trunk, radiating fronds and coconuts.

symbols.name: TerrainProps.createScrub
symbols.doc: Builds dry desert grass / sagebrush tuft.

symbols.name: TerrainProps.createSteerSkull
symbols.doc: Builds a steer skull landmark (western desert cow skull with horns).

symbols.name: TerrainProps.createTrailPost
symbols.doc: Builds a weathered wooden trail marker post.

symbols.name: TerrainProps.createTree
symbols.doc: Builds a twisted desert deadwood tree or dry desert acacia.

symbols.name: TerrainProps.createWagonWheel
symbols.doc: Builds an abandoned wooden wagon wheel half-buried in the sand.

symbols.name: TextureManager.createShadowMesh
symbols.doc: High-performance contact shadow mesh sharing a single texture and material.

symbols.name: TextureManager.preloadAll
symbols.doc: Preloads all entity sprite sheets upfront to eliminate mid-game texture loading hitch.

symbols.name: TreeManager.createTreeMesh
symbols.doc: Creates a pseudo-3D tree mesh with directional silhouette shadow matching monsters and heroes.

symbols.name: UIEventBus
symbols.doc: Lightweight, zero-dependency UI Event Bus for decoupled cross-module communication.

symbols.name: UNIQUE_CHARACTERS
symbols.doc: Registry of unique characters. Easily extensible for future unique characters.

symbols.name: UniqueCharacterConfig
symbols.doc: Unique Character Specification. Defines exclusive weapons, restriction rules, and future expansion properties.

symbols.name: unpackHostSnapshot
symbols.doc: Unpacks an ArrayBuffer back into a complete HostSnapshotMessage object.

symbols.name: UpdateNotificationUI
symbols.doc: Handles the visual presentation of the game update notification. Designed to be non-intrusive (never pauses the game, doesn't capture gameplay keystrokes, auto-collapses during combat, and re-expands when the run finishes).

symbols.name: UpdateNotificationUI.onRunEnded
symbols.doc: Called when player dies, wins, or returns to main menu (peaceful phase). Re-expands the banner with a run-completion reminder.

symbols.name: UpdateNotificationUI.preventFocusLoss
symbols.doc: Prevents UI buttons from capturing keyboard focus (e.g. Space to dash, WASD to move).

symbols.name: UpdateNotificationUI.setCombatActive
symbols.doc: Called by Game / HUD when entering gameplay.

symbols.name: UpdateNotifier
symbols.doc: UpdateNotifier checks for new client builds/patches deployed to the host. Emits non-intrusive notifications when an update is available without disrupting active gameplay.

symbols.name: UpdateNotifier.applyUpdate
symbols.doc: Applies update by clearing caches and reloading page.

symbols.name: UpdateNotifier.init
symbols.doc: Initializes polling and listeners.

symbols.name: UpdateNotifier.simulateUpdate
symbols.doc: Simulates an update event (useful for UI testing and verification in Dev mode).

symbols.name: useGameStore
symbols.doc: Global game lifecycle store for game states, timers, and dev mode. Uses subscribeWithSelector middleware for fine-grained non-re-rendering subscriptions.

symbols.name: useLobbyStore
symbols.doc: Co-op Lobby store coordinating network rooms, slots, and peer readiness.

symbols.name: usePlayerStore
symbols.doc: Player store featuring dual-frequency updates: - Continuous meters (HP, shields, XP, credits) are throttled at 15 Hz to prevent React re-render thrashing. - Discrete events (death, boss spawns, level-up, damage flash) update with 0ms latency.

symbols.name: useUIModalStore
symbols.doc: UI Modal store coordinating modal stack, overlays, and card draft dialogs.

symbols.name: VfxEnvironment
symbols.doc: Ambient environmental VFX component for The Rift. Renders drifting dust motes and optional celestial portal aura without garbage collection spikes.

symbols.name: VolatileRingInstance
symbols.doc: Visual effect instance for the Volatile elite affix lightning discharge. Displays a 0.65s ground telegraph circle before detonating an expanding electric shockwave.

symbols.name: VolatileRingManager
symbols.doc: Global manager for Volatile elite affix lightning telegraphs and shockwave detonations.

symbols.name: WhirlwindSlashWeapon
symbols.doc: Crimson Whirlwind (Багровый Вихрь) - Hero 4 Ronin starting weapon Rapid fury twin-slash storm unleashing crimson blade whirlwinds at extreme attack speed.

symbols.name: WorldChunks
symbols.doc: Declarative R3F container for terrain chunks. Enforces scene ownership guardrail: mounts chunks via stable keys without mutating R3F scene directly.
